replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

variantOf.description: The unit this is a Unit Variant of. A variant file lists only what differs, against unit-variant.schema.json; the loader merges it over its parent.

description.description: A sentence or two on what it's for, shown in its info popover.

upkeep.description: Charged at each Payday for each living unit, from training until death. Left out is none.

commandPoints.description: Command Points one unit occupies, from queue to death.

maxCount.description: Per-player limit, counted from queue to death.

slotLimit.description: The most of this unit one Unit Slot holds; more take another slot. Unset is no limit.

trainable.description: False keeps it off every building's trains, and its variants with it: a garrison or Starting Kit unit. Defaults to true.

roles.description: Hints for the Battle AI: which roles it picks this unit for first. A scout roams to look and falls back from the enemy; a skirmisher patrols between points and hunts what it's good against. A scout, infiltration or shock unit can Raid. Only an aa unit can fire on a Dropship.

carry.description: A Dropship: the Command Points of units it lands in a Battle already under way, once a Battle. It never fires.

model.description: Its 3D model in a Battle: a .glb, forward along +z, a cell 1 unit wide: one body mesh coloured by vertex colours, plus an optional mesh whose material is named trim, drawn in the side's colour. Left out, a placeholder shape.
